Skin Note
THE CLAIM
“Niacinamide and vitamin C cancel each other out.”
Refuted myth
Safe to combine
WHY
The myth traces to decades-old studies on raw, unformulated ingredients at high heat. In modern formulas the two are widely used together and can support a brighter-looking, more even complexion.
Evidence grade
Refuted · broad consensus
Reviewed by a board-certified dermatologist. Source: Peer-reviewed formulation literature.
✦
General cosmetic information. For the appearance of skin, not medical advice.
